title: Tehran, Sep 8, Esmaeil Baqaei, Iran FM Spox made some remarks in an interview.
text:
Tehran, Sep 8, Esmaeil Baqaei, Iran FM Spox made some remarks in an interview."

""
"SOT1, Esmaeil Baqaei, Iran FM Spox (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:09): "The trip [Iran’s President] to India to attend the BRICS summit will hopefully take place on Friday or Saturday.”"

""
"SOT2, Esmaeil Baqaei, Iran FM Spox (Farsi) (00:10 - 00:41): "The trip is definitely important because the multilateral arrangements of both Shanghai and BRICS are very important for us, and as you know, both organizations have expanded in various economic and trade fields in recent years. Therefore, we must utilize these opportunities, both for bilateral consultations with the member countries of these two organizations and for the transformation of positions.”
